understanding.goal_understanding: Place every selectable piece onto a goal tile marked '+'; the level and game are won only when all goals are occupied simultaneously.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Clicking selects or moves the currently selected piece toward the clicked grid position, subject to obstacles and walls. Pieces can push movable objects when space permits, but blocked paths or invalid targets leave the piece unmoved while still consuming a step. Efficient planning is essential because each level has a finite step budget.
